panels.description:
AgentRun objects the cluster still holds for the selected agents.
kube-state-metrics reads the live objects, so this is inventory, not a lifetime total: once a run is garbage collected it leaves every panel on this dashboard.
panels.title: Runs Retained

panels.description: Runs whose phase is Running. A run stuck here far longer than the agent's timeout usually means the harness pod is wedged rather than the work being slow.
panels.title: Running Now

panels.description: Runs whose phase is Failed. The exit code and error live on the object: kubectl -n automation get agentrun <name> -o jsonpath='{.status.error}'.
panels.title: Failed Runs

panels.description:
Succeeded over Succeeded plus Failed across retained runs. Pending, Running and Skipped are excluded from both sides, so a queue of pending runs does not move it.
Empty until at least one run has finished.
panels.title: Success Rate

targets.expr:
100 * (
  (count(sympozium_agentrun_info{ensemble=~"$ensemble", agent=~"$agent", phase="Succeeded"}) or vector(0))
  /
  count(sympozium_agentrun_info{ensemble=~"$ensemble", agent=~"$agent", phase=~"Succeeded|Failed"})
)

panels.description:
Sum of status.costEstimate over retained runs, in USD.
Only providers present in the pricing table contribute: ollama runs locally and is priced at zero, and openrouter only has an entry because pricing.extraEntries adds one in releases/automation/values/sympozium.yaml.gotmpl. A run from a provider with no entry is silently missing here rather than counted as zero.
panels.title: Estimated Cost

panels.description: Age of the newest completedAt across retained runs. The scheduled agents run at least daily, so a value far past a day means the schedule controller stopped creating runs rather than a quiet day.
panels.title: Time Since Last Run

panels.description:
How many retained runs sit in each phase over time.
This is a census of live objects, not a rate: the line rises as runs accumulate and drops when they are garbage collected. Read the Running series for concurrency and the Failed series for a backlog that nobody has cleared.
panels.title: Runs by Phase

panels.description: Retained runs per agent over time. A line that flattens while the others keep climbing is an agent whose schedule stopped firing.
panels.title: Runs by Agent

panels.description:
One row per retained AgentRun.
Every column is joined on the run name, so a run missing a value shows blank rather than dropping out: Cost is empty for providers with no pricing entry, and Duration, tokens and Tools are empty until the harness reports usage, which it only does once the run finishes.
Ensemble and Trigger come from labels the controller sets, and a run started from a channel rather than a schedule carries neither.
This lists what the cluster still holds. Runs are garbage collected, so it is not a full history.
panels.title: Runs

targets.expr: sum by (name, agent, ensemble, trigger, phase, model, provider) (sympozium_agentrun_info{ensemble=~"$ensemble", agent=~"$agent"})

panels.description: Input plus output tokens summed over the runs each agent still has retained. Useful for spotting the agent whose system prompt or context is doing the most work per run.
panels.title: Tokens by Agent

panels.description: Cost estimate summed per agent, in USD. Agents on ollama sit at zero because local inference is priced at zero, so this effectively ranks the agents pointed at a paid provider.
panels.title: Estimated Cost by Agent

panels.description: Mean of the duration the harness reported, per agent. It covers the agent loop only, so pod scheduling and image pull time are not included.
panels.title: Average Duration by Agent

panels.description: Which model served the retained runs. The split between the local and the paid model is what the cost panels above are explained by.
panels.title: Runs by Model

panels.description: What started each run, from the sympozium.ai/type label. Runs started from a channel carry no such label and group together under an empty name.
panels.title: Runs by Trigger

panels.description:
Available replicas of the four sympozium control-plane Deployments. The apiserver serves the UI and API, the controller-manager turns AgentRun objects into Jobs, the webhook admits them, and the collector receives their OTLP traffic.
A drop to zero on the controller-manager stops new runs from ever starting, and nothing else on this dashboard would show it, since the run panels only reflect objects that already exist.
panels.title: Available Replicas

panels.description: Restarts per container over the last hour. A collector restarting repeatedly loses the traces and metrics buffered in it, which shows up as gaps rather than errors.
panels.title: Container Restarts (1h)

panels.description: CPU seconds per second per control-plane container, averaged over 5m.
panels.title: CPU Usage

list.description: Ensembles to include. A run started from a channel rather than an ensemble schedule carries no ensemble label and is only visible under All.
list.label: Ensemble
list.name: ensemble

list.description: Agents to include, narrowed by the ensemble selection.
list.label: Agent
list.name: agent
